description: The bundled Next.js UI, served by the Bun sidecar on the loopback interface. In Tauri v2 a `remote` capability grants the listed origin access to the IPC layer and therefore to local system capabilities, so this file is deliberately the narrowest thing that still works: the scheme is pinned to http, the host is pinned to the literal 127.0.0.1, and the ONLY variable component is the ephemeral port, written as the URLPattern named group `:port` rather than a wildcard. It grants one permission — listening for tray navigation events. It grants no window control, no filesystem, no shell, no notification.
